# Summary

The charter states that each member pays a yearly contribution. The amount of this contribution is fixed in the annex of the charter[[cite:obs-a66ad167fae230699a6c31c1644b610bfc638662 "Each member pays a yearly contribution; the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter."]]. According to the annex, the ordinary contribution is one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January[[cite:obs-865d0a1bdb659d3608fea1b5ce3ad25f57bb8415 "Ordinary contributions: one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January."]].
